Question: For \(135^\circ \lt x \lt 180^\circ,\) points \(P = (\cos x, \cos^2 x),\) \(Q = (\cot x, \cot^2 x),\) \(R = (\sin x, \sin^2 x),\) and \(S = (\tan x, \tan^2 x)\) are the vertices of a trapezoid. What is \(\sin(2x)?\)
